title: Gaussian Approximation of Besov Functions for Logistic Classification on Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2610.27022v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study Gaussian kernel approximation and regularized logistic classification on a connected compact smooth embedded manifold $X\subset\mathbb R^d$ without boundary and of intrinsic dimension $\varrho$. Two main challenges are to derive a fast oracle inequality without assuming a bounded Bayes function and to construct Gaussian approximants that exploit both the intrinsic dimension and the target's regularity without saturation. We address the first challenge through a Bernstein-type inequality whose constant depends linearly on the supremum norm of the predictor. Combined with localized complexity estimates, this yields an oracle inequality over separable normed function spaces. To address the second challenge, we establish a uniform Sobolev operator expansion and cancel its lower-order bias terms using a signed combination of Gaussian kernel integral operators at different bandwidths. Real interpolation then gives an $L_2(X)$ approx

translated_title: 流形上逻辑斯蒂分类的Besov函数高斯逼近
translated_abstract: 我们研究了连通、紧致、光滑的嵌入流形 $X\subset\mathbb R^d$（无边界，内在维度为 $\varrho$）上的高斯核逼近与正则化逻辑斯蒂分类问题。两个主要挑战分别是：在不假设贝叶斯函数有界的前提下推导快速的预言机不等式，以及构造既能利用内在维度又能利用目标函数正则性、且不出现饱和现象的高斯逼近器。对于第一个挑战，我们通过一个Bernstein型不等式加以解决，该不等式中的常数与预测器的上确界范数呈线性依赖关系。结合局部化的复杂度估计，由此得到了可分赋范函数空间上的预言机不等式。针对第二个挑战，我们建立了一个一致的Sobolev算子展开，并利用不同带宽下高斯核积分算子的带符号组合来抵消其低阶偏差项。随后通过实插值方法，进而得到Besov函数的 $L_2(X)$ 逼近（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对紧致光滑流形上的正则化逻辑斯蒂分类，借助常数线性依赖预测器上确界范数的Bernstein型不等式得到无需有界贝叶斯假设的快速预言机不等式，并通过多带宽高斯核积分算子的带符号组合与实插值方法，构造出同时利用内在维度与目标正则性且无饱和现象的Besov函数高斯逼近。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a fast oracle inequality for regularized logistic classification on compact smooth manifolds without assuming a bounded Bayes function, via a Bernstein-type inequality with a constant depending linearly on the predictor's supremum norm, and constructs Gaussian approximants of Besov functions that exploit both intrinsic dimension and target regularity without saturation by combining Gaussian kernel integral operators at different bandwidths with real interpolation.
